remarks: Get ready to be wowed by this fabulous 2nd floor oversized 1-bedroom ranch unit with a versatile laundry/office space. You have a large eat-in Kitchen plus dining room and enormous living room with a Bay Window. This unit is located off Shippan Ave, just steps from the beach, easy access to the train station and I-95, making it an ideal choice for those commuting into the city.  Enjoy the convenience of (2) reserved parking spaces and the in-unit laundry. Step out onto your private deck or enjoy access to the yard, perfect for relaxing after a long day.  ALL UTILITIES ARE INCLUDED, EXCELLENT CREDIT A MUST! NO PETS.   Don't miss the chance to make this exceptional space your own!
